adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, feed item HTML is taken from `i.content` (after `CGI.unescapeHTML` and `.scrub`) and passed to `TopicEmbed.import` without any sanitization. `TopicEmbed.import` creates a post with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` verbatim for `:raw_html`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed view then renders it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. This combination makes stored XSS from malicious RSS/Atom content directly verifiable from the diff.
